snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky — Enhanced Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky — a prequel of the story, in which as Scar, a battle-hardened you'll fight your way through a war-raging Zone. Influence Faction Wars and shape the fragile alliances and rivalries that determine who survives the ever-shifting battle in this anomalous lands.
Now transformed with enhanced lighting, godrays, screen space reflections, and global illumination that amplify the Zone’s legendary atmosphere. Available on May 20, 2025, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Full FAQ:  https://www.stalker-game.com/en/faq
